title: RadioVIL: Anomaly-Aware Diffusion Models for Radio Map Inpainting and Zero-Shot Vehicle Localization
abstract: arXiv:2608.16167v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-precision radio map construction is essential for emerging 6G Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) applications, including digital twins and intelligent transportation. However, existing deep learning methods predominantly treat this as a pure image completion task, resulting in over-smoothed reconstructions that fundamentally erase high-frequency scattering signatures of dynamic physical entities such as hidden vehicles. To overcome this, we propose RadioVIL, an efficient two-stage framework that reformulates joint radio map inpainting and zero-shot vehicle localization as a prior-guided physical inverse problem. Specifically, we first train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) to capture the structural generative prior of the environment. translated_title: RadioVIL：面向无线电图修复与零样本车辆定位的异常感知扩散模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16167v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：高精度无线电图构建对于新兴的6G集成感知与通信（ISAC）应用至关重要，包括数字孪生和智能交通。然而，现有的深度学习方法主要将其视为纯图像补全任务，导致重建结果过度平滑，从根本上抹除了动态物理实体（如隐藏车辆）的高频散射特征。为克服此问题，我们提出RadioVIL，一种高效的两阶段框架，将联合无线电图修复与零样本车辆定位重新表述为先验引导的物理逆问题。具体而言，我们首先训练一个去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）以捕获环境的结构生成先验。在从高度稀疏测量进行推理时，我们采用一种基于扩散的中间层优化（DMILO）算法。通过优化一个L1正则化的空间...
tldr: 本文提出RadioVIL框架，利用扩散模型和DMILO算法，将无线电图修复与零样本车辆定位作为物理逆问题处理，避免过度平滑并保留高频散射特征。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RadioVIL, a framework leveraging diffusion models and DMILO algorithm to treat radio map inpainting and zero-shot vehicle localization as a physical inverse problem, avoiding over-smoothing and preserving high-frequency scattering features.
